apps.name: PureLive
apps.versionDescription:
# 纯粹直播 v2.9.5
|版本|下载地址|
|---|---|
|TV版|[pure_live_TV](https://github.com/liuchuancong/pure_live_TV/releases/latest)|
|Windows/macOS/Android/iOS版|[pure_live](https://github.com/liuchuancong/pure_live/releases/latest)|
### 🖥️ Windows 版
- **Portable ZIP**：解压即用，无需安装
- **EXE 安装包**：适合所有用户
- **MSIX 包**：现代应用格式，支持干净卸载
- 适配：Windows 10/11 x64
### 🍎 macOS 版
- macOS 桌面版
- Universal：Apple Silicon + Intel
- ZIP / DMG
### 📱 Android 版
- Android 6.0+
- ARM64-v8a
- ARMv7
- x86_64
- 统一 SHA256 校验文件：[**ANDROID_SHA256SUM.txt**](https://github.com/liuchuancong/pure_live/releases/download/v2.9.5/ANDROID_SHA256SUM.txt)
### 🐧 Linux 版
- Linux x64
- Portable tar.gz
### 🍎 iOS 版
- unsigned iOS device application
- TrollStore / ad-hoc IPA
- ARM64
### 🔧 Build Metadata
[**BUILD_METADATA.json**](https://github.com/liuchuancong/pure_live/releases/download/v2.9.5/BUILD_METADATA.json)
### 📝 本次更新
- 修复斗鱼直播。
- 新增YY直播以及搜索。
- 新增多画面同看、纯 Dart 平台签名与语言切换修复，并保留维护分支播放器、弹幕和高刷新率增强。
- 修复 Windows MSIX 数据路径提供器，商店式安装使用系统隔离目录，便携版继续使用安装目录内 A
apps.localizedDescription: 支持哔哩哔哩、虎牙、斗鱼、抖音等平台的开源直播聚合播放器。

apps.name: Aidoku
apps.versionDescription:
- Fixes for iOS 27: fixed settings pages freezing the app, along with other minor visual issues.
- Improved backup restore time: restores should now take seconds instead of minutes. (@Amqx)
- Failed download page retrying: less chance of missing pages in downloaded chapters from sources with aggressive rate limits. (@pxseu)
- New chapter notifications (experimental): when Aidoku refreshes in the background, notification(s) of new chapters should be sent if enabled. (@Zareix)
- Various other bug fixes and small features: see [the website](<https://aidoku.app/release-notes/>) for a more complete list.
